full_text: There's a slogan that reads, charging an electric car is charging the energy of the earth. This means that you get to play a role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions by driving eco-friendly vehicles. An exhibition took place to showcase a wide range of electric cars and related equipment. Let's take a look. This is an electric car that emits less carbon dioxide and air pollutants. If you connect this car with a charger, it provides electric current through a transmission. The Ministry of Environment, Seoul Metropolitan Government and Korea Environment Corporation have greatly established infrastructure for electric cars. Last year, we established a charging system to feed up to 500 electric cars. We plan to build another one with a capacity of 2600 vehicles this year, and if this takes place, more electric cars will come into place, which will lead to carbon emissions reduction and air quality improvement. This is a machine that accesses data of electric voltage and current for efficient use of electric vehicles. As it can estimate the efficiency rate, it's useful when conducting research in development. The 2012 ElectroViHycle and Smart Car exhibition was held on October 17th to display eco-friendly electroViHycles and related equipment. Manufacturers of electric vehicles related industries including two wheel vehicles, parts and materials, charging systems participated in this exhibition. This is a business fair that is aimed at facilitating exchanges between professionals in the electric vehicle industry. This fair presented diverse electroViHycles, auto parts and analysis system, as well as all electric battery powered buses. Oversists, market seminars were held on the side line of the event to give information to Korean electric car manufacturers. ElectroViHycles had reduced greenhouse gas emissions and air pollutants. To raise penetration rate of electric cars, companies will have to endeavor to develop advanced technologies.
